parse.text:
Overview

Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Shadow Sorcerer.

Evolving

Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow) can evolve into Shadow Sorcerer (Incident) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow) is one of two units along with Blackhair that can curse enemies, making them take more magic damage.
  • On update 20.0 , Shade Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow) can be evolved into Shadow Sorcerer (Incident).
    • Along with Priest and Illusionist, it has the most evolution form in the game.
